prompt: Chain Optionals to dig through a Customer that may be null at every layer, returning the lowercased city or "unknown".
explanation: Each map call runs only when the Optional holds a value, and a mapper that returns null (a null address or city) collapses the chain to empty automatically -- that is what makes one Optional chain null-safe at every layer. orElse supplies the fallback once, at the end, instead of one null check per layer. Using toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) keeps the result deterministic regardless of the machine's locale.
hints: Start with java.util.Optional.ofNullable(c) so a null Customer is handled by the same chain.
Chain .map(Customer::address).map(Address::city) -- map is skipped when the Optional is empty, and a mapper returning null yields an empty Optional.
Finish with one more map that lower-cases the city -- pass Locale.ROOT so the result cannot depend on the machine's language -- and let orElse supply the fallback text.
